title: pi-sgrep configuration
description: Configuration for the pi-sgrep extension. Place this file at ~/.pi/agent/pi-sgrep.json, or set PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR to relocate it.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, for editor completion.

binary.description: Path to the sgrep binary. Resolved through PATH, then ~/.cargo/bin and the Homebrew prefixes, when omitted. Also settable with PI_SGREP_BIN or SGREP_BIN.

rgPath.description: Path to the ripgrep binary used by the sgrep_rank tool. Resolved through PATH when omitted.

cacheDir.description: Directory for sgrep models and search indexes, passed as --cache-dir when the installed build supports it. Models land in <dir>/hub and indexes in <dir>/index.

model.description: Embedding model. auto uses text embeddings when every candidate passage is prose (.md, .txt) and code embeddings otherwise. Default auto.

timeoutMs.description: Per-search timeout in milliseconds. The first search in a directory also downloads the embedding model. Default 120000.

maxResults.description: Default number of ranked passages returned per search. Default 8.

maxResultsCap.description: Hard ceiling on the limit a model may request. Default 50.

maxLinesPerResult.description: Maximum source lines printed per result before truncation. Default 80.

maxTotalLines.description: Maximum source lines printed across all results of one call. Default 240.

maxLineLength.description: Maximum characters kept per source line. Default 500.

allowLargeRoots.description: Allow searching $HOME or the filesystem root. Refused by default, because sgrep would index everything under them.

extraArgs.description: Extra arguments appended to every sgrep invocation, for options this extension does not surface.
